exposure: Insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1) levels in serum and placenta
Insulin-like growth factor-1 receptor (IGF-1R) levels in serum and placenta
cohort: The study included 22 patients with preeclampsia and 22 normal pregnant women who underwent cesarean section deliveries at the First Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University.
finding: Levels of IGF-1 and IGF-1R in both serum and placental tissue were significantly lower in preeclamptic pregnant women, showing potential as biomarkers for PE diagnosis and positive correlations with neonatal birth weight.
cross-section timing: At the time of cesarean section deliveries between December 2021 and December 2022.
